feature_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
feature_patient_access: This website is for staff. Patients use the mobile app.
feature_rate_limited_seconds: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
feature_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
feature_network_error: Could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
feature_login_error: Could not sign in. Try again.
feature_password_max: The password must not exceed 128 characters.
feature_registration_direct_lead: Search for the patient by document, register them if they do not exist and record their arrival.
feature_confirm_conflict: This pre-registration is no longer pending or the patient already has an active encounter.
feature_reject_conflict: This pre-registration is no longer pending.
feature_verify_identity: I checked the identity of the patient present against their document.
feature_no_patient: No patient was found with that document.
feature_patient_conflict: A patient with that document already exists.
feature_birth_future: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
feature_arrival_conflict: The patient already has a pending pre-registration or an active encounter. Check the inbox.
feature_arrival_invalid: The location or patient is no longer valid.
feature_reason_max: The reason must not exceed 500 characters.
feature_age_invalid: The estimated age must be a whole number between 0 and 120.
feature_name_max: The name must not exceed 200 characters.
feature_document_max: The document number must not exceed 64 characters.
feature_age_choose: Provide the date of birth or estimated age.
feature_complaint_max: The chief complaint must not exceed 2000 characters.
feature_forbidden_action: You do not have permission to perform this action.
feature_action_error: Could not complete the action. Try again.
feature_encounters_lead: Browse encounters by status and location.
feature_cancel_conflict: The encounter is already closed or cancelled.
clinical_tray_intro: Record clinical information for encounters awaiting triage.
clinical_tray_error: Unable to load encounters awaiting triage.
clinical_tray_empty: No encounters are awaiting triage with these filters.
clinical_capture_intro: Review the context and record each measurement or finding separately.
clinical_read_only: This encounter is no longer awaiting triage. You can view captures; new records are blocked.
clinical_state_error: Unable to verify the status. Refresh the encounter before recording again.
clinical_guide_tray: This is the nursing tray. The indicator shows how many encounters are waiting for triage. The list updates on its own periodically; use Refresh to check right away. Select a site and open an encounter to record clinical information. Use Previous and Next to change pages.
clinical_guide_capture: Review the encounter context. Complete and save the vital signs. In the other form, add symptoms, findings or chief complaint notes. The forms save separately. Review captures in the history. The guide does not read clinical data.
clinical_guide_detail: Review encounter details, the clinical history available to your role and the timeline. Nursing staff can open capture when the encounter is awaiting triage. The guide does not read patient data.
clinical_provisional: PROVISIONAL — not clinically validated; review with a clinical adviser.
clinical_temperature_precision: Temperature allows at most one decimal place.
clinical_pressure_order: Systolic pressure must be greater than diastolic pressure.
clinical_description_max: The description allows at most {max} characters.
clinical_findings_max: Each capture allows at most {max} items.
clinical_original_readonly: The original chief complaint cannot be changed; use a note to clarify it.
clinical_save_error: Unable to save the capture. Try again.
clinical_conflict: This encounter is no longer available for capture. Its status is being checked.
dash_reception_lead: Confirm the arrival of pre-registered patients or register a direct arrival.
dash_reception_empty_hint: When a patient submits one from the app, it will appear here.
dash_triage_empty_hint: Arrivals confirmed by reception will appear here.
suggestion_load_error: The suggestion could not be loaded.
suggestion_empty: No suggestion has been requested for this encounter yet.
suggestion_needs_vitals: Save a set of vital signs first to request the suggestion.
suggestion_requesting: Requesting the suggestion from the AI… This can take up to 20 seconds.
suggestion_proposal_notice: AI proposal, not a decision. Nursing decides the triage level.
suggestion_guard_reason: Rule {rule} (NEWS2 total {total}) limits the level to {maxLevel} at most.
suggestion_manual: There is no valid suggestion. Triage for this encounter will be manual.
suggestion_conflict: The suggestion could not be requested: the encounter changed. Its status is being checked.
suggestion_outdated: Data was recorded after this suggestion. You can request another one.
decision_error_level_same: The corrected level must be different from the suggested one.
decision_error_reason: Write the reason for the correction.
decision_waiting_suggestion: Wait for the suggestion to load to record the triage.
decision_conflict_changed: The triage could not be recorded: the suggestion changed. Review the current suggestion before continuing.
decision_already_decided: This encounter already had a recorded triage; yours was not saved.
decision_load_error: The recorded triage could not be loaded.
queue_lead: Active encounters by triage level and waiting time.
queue_refresh_failed: Could not refresh the queue. Showing data as of {time}.
queue_confirm_start_body: {patient}, level {level}. The encounter will move to “In care” and the waiting time will stop counting.
queue_confirm_close_body: {patient}, level {level}. The encounter will be closed and will leave the queue. This cannot be undone.
queue_conflict_start: This encounter is no longer triaged. The queue was refreshed.
queue_conflict_close: This encounter is no longer in care. The queue was refreshed.
queue_gone: This encounter no longer exists. The queue was refreshed.
queue_action_forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
reports_lead: Times, compliance, agreement and fallback use for the encounters in a period.
reports_error_bad_request: The dates are not valid. Check From and To.
reports_error_period: The period is not valid: From cannot be later than To and the period cannot exceed 366 days.
reports_empty: There are no encounters for this period and location.
reports_refresh_failed: The indicators could not be refreshed. Showing those calculated on {datetime}.
reports_care_title: Triage I and II: from classification to care
reports_care_note: Minutes from classification to medical care. The mean is the indicator of Resolution 256 of 2016.
reports_level1_note: Level I: immediate care, no compliance percentage.
reports_kappa_note: With few pairs the kappa is unreliable.
reports_under: Under-triage: the AI suggested a less severe level than the final one
reports_over: Over-triage: the AI suggested a more severe level than the final one
reports_matrix_caption: Agreement matrix: rows, level suggested by the AI; columns, final level (nursing)
reports_csv_notice: Internal format, not the official Resolution 373 / SISPRO report.
reports_csv_forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
